title: Section 528 BNSS — Inherent powers of the High Court

content.overview: Section 528 saves the High Court's inherent power to prevent abuse of process and secure the ends of justice. It replaces CrPC 482.
content.study: Do not confuse this with BNSS 482 anticipatory bail. Quashing of a complaint or FIR is argued here. It is not a substitute for appeal or revision where those lie.
